name: complex-analysis-suite
description: Monorepo for a suite of complex-analysis / complex-dynamics visualization tools that share packages and hand data off to one another.
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run lint && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run lint
scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run build
